name: Data Browser Kernel Plant (Web)
implementation_notes: KernelPlantRecordService/Controller/routes/seeder/factories are shared infrastructure for all 3 web Kernel Plant screens (052/056/060), mirroring DepricarpingRecordService's precedent (screen-051) -- reported under this screen since it is first in the implementation sequence

KernelPlantRecord/KernelPlantDetail/KernelPlantOperationalTarget Eloquent models and their 3 migrations already existed prior to this task (generated by an earlier impl-1-core/entity-models pass covering all 4 new stations) -- this screen's work only added the service/controller/routes/seeder/factories/Livewire layer on top of that existing schema, no new migrations were needed

REVISED 2026-08-24 (entity-catalog v12, replacing the original fixed 24-row design the user explicitly rejected -- Kernel Plant is the LAST of the 4 new stations to receive this fix): KernelPlantRecordService::create()/update()'s row-population logic changed to mirror DepricarpingRecordService's fixed pattern exactly -- create() now inserts only the given detail rows (1..24, unique + strictly ascending canonical time_slot) instead of forcing exactly 24, update() upserts by id (insert rows without an id, update rows whose id still appears, delete any existing row whose id is no longer present) instead of UPDATE-only; the 3 Eloquent models/migrations listed above did NOT need to change, only the service's row-handling methods (create()/update()/validateDetails()/upsertDetails(), replacing insertDetails()/updateDetails())

filled_slot_count computed via withCount() with an inner OR-whereNotNull constraint across all 9 reading columns (mirrors DepricarpingRecordService's filled_slot_count pattern exactly, adapted for Kernel Plant's own column names: ripple_mill_1_amps, ripple_mill_2_amps, claybath_hydro_sg, kernel_silo_1_temp_c, kernel_silo_2_temp_c, kernel_moisture_percent, shell_loss_percent, downtime_minutes, findings) -- UNCHANGED by this revision, this Data Browser screen never assumed a fixed 24-row count

STRUCTURAL SHAPE MATCHES DEPRICARPING (downtime_minutes + findings split), but the Operational Target table itself is 3-column (equipment_parameter/target_benchmark/corrective_action_plan) matching Threshing's/Pressing's shape, NOT Depricarping's 4-column shape -- KernelPlantOperationalTargetSeeder keyed on equipment_parameter (not parameter_metric like Depricarping's seeder), UNTOUCHED by this revision
StationFactory's kernelPlant() state (type=StationType::KernelPlant) unchanged by this revision

KernelPlantRecordServiceTest.php rewritten to mirror DepricarpingRecordServiceTest.php's dynamic-row test shape (create() with 1..N rows instead of always-24, update() upsert semantics including delete-on-removal) -- 32 tests total (up from the pre-fix 32, replacing the fixed-24-row test set one-for-one)

Ran the full backend Pest suite after this pass: 1299/1299 passing (up from the pre-fix baseline of 1287/1287, which already included Threshing's/Pressing's/Depricarping's fixes), confirming zero regressions across all 4 new stations and every other existing station -- Kernel Plant being the last of the 4 means the whole entity-catalog v12 dynamic-row migration is now complete project-wide

DatabaseSeeder.php's KernelPlantOperationalTargetSeeder registration unchanged by this revision; migrations for all 3 kernel_plant_* tables were already applied on the dev database.sqlite prior to this pass.

It has not been updated to add a Kernel Plant tile linking to /data/kernel-plant. This screen is reachable directly by URL/route but not yet from that entry-point grid. Needs a separate revision of screen-035 (shared across all 4 new-station agent runs, not owned by any single one -- Threshing's/Pressing's/Depricarping's implement artifacts document the identical gap; this is the cross-cutting cleanup a future session should perform now that all 4 stations are done).

Browser (Playwright) spec (backend/tests/Browser/DataBrowserKernelPlantTest.php) was authored following this codebase's established convention (a .php file containing Playwright TS syntax, excluded from phpunit.xml's testsuites, meant to be run separately via `playwright test` against a live dev server) but was NOT executed against the web (Laravel Livewire) app in this pass -- verified only by static review, consistent with every other backend Browser/* spec in this codebase. This screen required no functional changes for the entity-catalog v12 revision (filled_slot_count logic already correct for a variable row count), so its Browser spec was left untouched.
